description: This is an AndroidJUnit4 test class for automating UI testing on Android devices. It defines a series of methods to interact with and retrieve information from UI components using UiAutomator and Accessibility APIs, and communicates over a local socket connection to perform various actions like clicking, scrolling, dragging, and introspecting UI elements. The class is also annotated with @RunWith for test execution and contains a main test method that runs an infinite loop handling socket communication for test commands.

classes.name: InstrumentedTest
classes.description: Android UI test class utilizing UiAutomator and Accessibility APIs, establishing socket communication for executing and reporting UI interactions on an Android device.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a BySelector for UI element identification based on specified attributes.

methods.name: parseTimeout
methods.description: Extracts a timeout value from JSON parameters, defaulting to 30000 milliseconds if not specified.

methods.name: parsePoint
methods.description: Constructs a Point object from JSON parameters specifying x and y coordinates.

methods.name: parseDirection
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a Direction enum value.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a UI element matching the selector to appear within a timeout, returning the element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets text in a UI element found via the selector.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs a click action on a UI element identified by the selector.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Performs a drag gesture on a UI element based on the specified parameters.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture in a specified direction with optional speed.

methods.name: longClick
methods.description: Performs a long click on a UI element matching the selector.

methods.name: pinchClose
methods.description: Performs a pinch close gesture with a specified percentage and speed.

methods.name: pinchOpen
methods.description: Performs a pinch open gesture with a specified percentage and speed.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls a UI element in a specified direction and percentage, with optional speed.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Performs a swipe gesture in a specified direction, with optional speed.

methods.name: serializeRect
methods.description: Converts a Rect object into a JSON representation.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed accessibility info of a UI element.

methods.name: info (AccessibilityNodeInfo)
methods.description: Serializes AccessibilityNodeInfo into a JSON object.

methods.name: inputPress
methods.description: Simulates a key press on the device.

methods.name: inputClick
methods.description: Simulates a click at a specific point on the device screen.

methods.name: inputSwipe
methods.description: Performs a swipe input gesture.

methods.name: inputDrag
methods.description: Performs a drag input gesture.

methods.name: tree
methods.description: Retrieves the accessibility node tree from the device.

methods.name: getRootA11yNode
methods.description: Uses reflection to access the root accessibility node via UiDevice.

methods.name: serializeA11yNode
methods.description: Recursively serializes an AccessibilityNodeInfo into JSON.
